changes.reason: Bind keyed Saga requests to canonical name/payload fingerprints before lookup/create reuse and preserve explicit replay semantics. Optional stored identity is additive; no durable Saga adapter or database schema exists in this package.

kubernetes.reason: Canonical Saga request identity uses the existing provider-neutral SagaStore and Web Crypto already used by Saga outbox identities; it adds no host, storage engine or deployment lifecycle requirement.
constraints: Stores must atomically reserve saga name/key and persist the optional requestFingerprint field. Legacy records compare their recorded payload without rewriting history. No deployed-host or provider certification is claimed.
